Asset type: Daggerfall Unity NPC portrait mouth atlas
Input image: Image 1 is the ONLY reference and edit target: the exact 3x3 grid of repeated lower portrait halves. Preserve its grid layout and every cell boundary.
Primary request: Edit only the lips and mouth interior in this supplied atlas to express a warm, gently happy emotion. Return the complete 3x3 atlas, row-major A B C / D E F / G H X, with no labels or added margins. Keep each lower-face crop aligned to its original cell.
Style/medium: subdued late-1990s fantasy pixel-art portrait, crisp native-grid pixels and restrained pixel clusters; no smooth vector shapes or painterly blur.
Rhubarb pose meanings, follow these exactly:
A: closed lightly pressured lips for P/B/M.
B: narrow horizontal opening with teeth nearly together, for consonants/EE.
C: medium relaxed unrounded opening for EH/AE.
D: wide vertical AA opening, visibly larger than C.
E: slightly rounded AO/ER opening, no wider than C.
F: small forward pucker for UW/OW/W; do not show teeth biting the lower lip.
G: upper teeth touching the lower lip for F/V; this is not a wide vowel and not a pucker.
H: tongue raised behind the upper teeth for L, with an opening between C and D; a tiny tongue may be invisible at 64px.
X: relaxed closed idle lips.
Expression: warm and happy, with subtle lifted corners and friendly relaxed lip tension. Retain that emotion across all poses without changing their mouth-shape families.
Color and scale: preserve original soft brown lips, muted warm tan skin, restrained highlights, and softly blended pixel-art contrast. Keep the original lip scale and face width. Teeth, where the pose requires them, are small and warm ivory, never bright white blocks. No lipstick-red, orange surrounding skin, new colors outside the reference palette, or broad grin.
Constraints: alter only lips and mouth interior in each cell. Preserve nose, cheeks, jaw, chin, hair, neck, background, crop, pixel placement, and 3x3 atlas structure. No text, symbols, decorations, or watermark.
